selected.rationale: The Convenience-First Millennial explicitly lists 'instant_delivery' and 'quick_commerce' in category affinities, aligning directly with the advertiser's core model of 10-minute grocery delivery and messaging preferences for speed and one-click buying.

The Busy Parent prioritizes convenience and food-related categories like meal kits and household goods, fitting the family household audience of Kitchenly and the time-saving value proposition of rapid grocery delivery.

The Value-Conscious Shopper focuses on groceries, household items, and clear value propositions, making them an ideal segment for mid-market grocery delivery services seeking everyday utility customers.

rejected.reason: The Wellness Optimizer focuses on specialized supplements, clean beauty, and organic groceries with low price sensitivity, whereas a 10-minute grocery delivery service relies on broad convenience and mid-market everyday essentials rather than niche health optimization.
The Gen Z Aesthete focuses on beauty, fashion, and identity-expressive items discovered through social media, which does not match the utilitarian and functional nature of rapid grocery delivery.
The Pet Parent is specifically interested in pet food, supplies, and health rather than human grocery delivery, making them a poor fit for general 10-minute grocery ads.

The Affluent Classic has an older age range (50-68) that falls outside the advertiser's target age max of 45 and relies on high-end luxury positioning and craftsmanship rather than speed and convenience.

The Sustainability Buyer focuses heavily on supply chain transparency, clean beauty, and specific eco-certifications, which goes beyond the core convenience-first messaging of a rapid grocery delivery app.
The Fitness Enthusiast focuses on activewear, supplements, and recovery products rather than general household groceries and rapid delivery services.

The Gifter is explicitly disinterested in self-care-only or everyday consumable framing, focusing instead on holiday-specific and premium-wrapped presentation purchases rather than routine grocery delivery.
